title: LQ-MARGINAL: exact joint clean-marginal one-third tolerance and linear quantum space

claims.statement: For every integer N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, set n=ceil(log2 N). Use the single LQ-MARGINAL algorithm of linear_quantum_marginal.md Section 0: K=2^n, a_n=ceil(sqrt(n+1)), A_scale=2^64*a_n, L=max{j>=0:9^j<=K}, B_j the least power of two at least A_scale*3^j, b_j=log2(B_j), exactly two deterministic dyadic blocks per coarse level, R_v=4*n+128 single verifier blocks at B_L, 1024 retained attempts, exactly Q=3*2^16*(n+32) deliveries and r=Q/3. Use the complete actual controller of linear_quantum_marginal_controller.md Section 3 and the full selected filter proof of linear_quantum_marginal_filter.md Sections 2-10. All four current proof files, including linear_quantum_marginal_model.md Sections 1-9 for the complete joint-input/channel/good-first/undo/endpoint proof, are required evidence for every claim. Each attempt has one logical probe and the shared verifier has one logical probe; include them in R_zero, U, its complete literal inverse and all allocated storage. No selector seeds or random Grover times are used. The N=2 branch omits the selector and its probes and retains the same Q, gradient and endpoint. Under every fixed joint input and every convex mixture in the exact fifth-claim clean-marginal model, including arbitrary bad-good/reference entanglement and the clean case, full-secret success is unconditionally at least 11/16 > 2/3. All four bounds hold jointly on every branch, including malformed records, retained verifier leakage, failed preparation and incorrect answers, with absolute constants independent of N, s, input state and outcomes. Total charged sequential work is T=O(2^{n/2} n^{7/2} (log2 n)^2), with exact representative-envelope growth index 1. This counts source charges, all bit/head/address operations and known-bit reads, actual circuit generation, gates, all literal inverses, measurements, resets, initialization, code/bound construction, recursion and every capped attempt. The logarithmic display applies for n>=2, with finite absolute cost at N=2. The fixed joint input is released in acquisition order by a passive source. All acquired rows and current input/work are counted; unread inaccessible-source state is excluded under the rules. The clean promise is on the original good marginal and is not imposed after conditioning on earlier outcomes.

structured.error_model: Among the Q acquired copies, an adversary fixes a set B of at most floor(epsilon(n) Q) malformed positions, possibly depending on N and s. The joint state is arbitrary subject to its reduced state on all other positions being exactly rho_s^{tensor (Q-|B|)}. Malformed systems may be correlated or entangled with each other and with other systems subject to that marginal promise. No source control, purification access, or preparation inverse is supplied.
